crop.notes: Allen notice is the middle of three Sporting Notes items; others are unrelated athletics and gun club notes

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's Sporting Notes carried a notice for Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, at No. 619 Market Street, offering free concerts every evening with only the best singers.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Wednesday, October 5, 1892, page 17

facts.fact: Allen, billed as retired champion pugilist of the world, ran a concert saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with free concerts every evening

notes: Short recurring advertising card under Sporting Notes; same text ran repeatedly in 1892.
